transformer.name: aws2-ddb:application-json
transformer.title: Aws2 Ddb (Application Json)
transformer.description: Prepares the message to perform a DynamoDB operation with the aws2-ddb component

transformerIn.description: A JSON object, or a Jackson JsonNode; the body is not read when the item or key header is set already

transformerOut.description: Sets the item, key, update values and operation headers of the aws2-ddb producer
